mainText: Hello, Verona! At 5 AM, here is today's balanced dish: we are seeing clear skies and a temperature of 49 degrees near Fireman's Park, with a lovely first quarter moon visible.

The City of Verona keeps you connected through the VHAT cable channel, which broadcasts government meetings, and the city blog which provides updates on council sessions and community resources. Don't forget to subscribe to the digital newsletter to stay informed about local programs and city-wide developments.

We have a busy day ahead! Join us today for yoga at Insight Wellness, the Concerts in the Park series at Century School Park, or team trivia at Hop Haus Brewing. Looking further ahead, we have live music starting tomorrow at Bailey's Run Vineyard and the Wisconsin Brewing Company.
Looking at the weekly police report, on Monday, July 13th, officers responded to a call where a driver had to be arrested for an O-W-I after their vehicle became trapped on a large rock.
Today's flavor is the fan-favorite Really Reese's. Please note the restaurant is currently closed, but they will be ready to serve you starting at 10:00 AM.
